body.justification: The explicit uniform deviation inequality is the load-bearing result that turns the latent Janson boundary into a finite-sample observable object.
body.gap: Janson2015 classifies zero long-run variance but supplies no test from randomized causal scores; FanLengWu2025 estimates the asymptotic variance of a regression-adjusted direct-effect estimator under a low-rank graphon model and does not give this two-wave finite-sample bound.
body.consumer: Repeated online experiments obtain a prespecified, regression-free error bar for the population component even when the null lies on a degenerate coboundary boundary.
